sentence: People who own a repository call Jano once from their AI agent, answer a few questions, and get back a README that a stranger understands from top to bottom: planned sections, text sized to fit, and a moving picture over the top and over each part that needs one, checked by a reader who never saw the project.

unfinished.item: A preview page to look at it before you publish
The agent sees the motion as stopped frames; you judge it in the preview

shows: a route of six stations
a repo folder travelling the route
station cards: read the repo, ask you, plan, draw, check, cold read
ticks left at each station passed
the finished README.md card at the end of the route

picture.claim: Before the README is done, a reader who has never seen the project looks at each picture with its words removed and says what it shows; the answer is held against what the picture was meant to say, and the picture passes or goes back to be redrawn.
shows: a section picture with its title cut away
a blank reader window that sees only the picture
the reader's answer typed out
the intended claim beside it
a pass stamp or a redraw arrow

picture.claim: Jano plans the README section by section: each one gets a job, a word budget and, when it helps, a picture of its own.
shows: a plan sheet with one row per section
role chips on each row
word budget bars filling
picture or no picture marks
a card naming the lit row

picture.claim: You call Jano once and answer a few questions, each with Jano's own suggestion, and after that it works without asking again.
shows: the agent chat with the /jano call
three questions with a suggested answer each
answers being picked
a closed question counter
work carrying on alone

icons.why: Jano's mark and scenes are drawn in 2 px rounded strokes on a 24 px grid, the same line Lucide uses
